changes.name: The Winter of 176
changes.entry:
During a catastrophic northern winter storm, a Drusha vessel encountered the wreckage of a Gravosk ship and rescued 176 Gravosk from the freezing sea.

The weather made returning them home impossible. Instead the Drusha sheltered the survivors through the remainder of winter. They fed them, clothed them, shared living space with them, and over the long months exchanged songs, stories, jokes, histories and skills.

When spring finally opened the sea lanes, the Drusha sailed every survivor home.

For a people who believe that Gravosk never forgets, the act could not simply disappear into history. The Winter of 176 became the foundation of the alliance between the Gravoska Kingdom and the Drusha.

The relationship frequently causes confusion on both sides. It has nevertheless survived war, political disputes and generations of misunderstanding.

Gamemaster Secret

Some surviving Drusha songs describe 177 Gravosk, not 176. Gravosk histories consistently insist there were only 176. Someone has been removed from the story. Nobody knows why.
